programs.title: Teletubbies
programs.desc: It's breakfast time for the children in Tummy Tales and in Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies wake up and can't decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast - so they have both!

programs.title: Sesame Street
programs.desc: It's Song Day on Sesame Street. Mia learns how to sing a song in Spanish with help from her friends Nina, Rosita, and Lalo. She learns that she's special just the way she is, no matter how much or little Spanish she speaks.

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: Daniel can't wait to show Margaret all of the things they can do to celebrate Thank You Day at the Enchanted Garden!

programs.title: Maddie & Triggs
programs.desc: With only minutes to go before the big performance at McGinty's Farm, Maddie has to use all her musical skills to convince Gary the Chicken to perform with the rest of the animals.

programs.title: Numberblocks
programs.desc: The Numberblocks have a bowling tournament, but which team is going to win the trophy? Their friend Rekenrek adds up the scores!

programs.title: Bing
programs.desc: Bing shows Nicky how to voosh the blue speedy car down the slide, but Nicky vooshes too, falling and breaking his glasses! Sula and Bing are upset but Nicky fixes his glasses.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Balls are so much fun to play with! Bowling balls, bouncing balls, basketballs, disco balls! Fizzy and Suds play with all their favourite balls!

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, but who can jump the highest?

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: A techno dance party to remember! The Wiggles are planning a surprise birthday party for Dorothy the Dinosaur, filled with all of her favourite things.

programs.title: Shaun the Sheep
programs.desc: The animals on Mossy Bottom Farm are holding their annual dance competition. The pigs are up to no good and attempt to cheat their way to victory. Can Bitzer and Shaun make sure that dancing justice prevails?

programs.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programs.desc: The kids decide to form a rock band with Paddington, but what instrument should he play and what is rock music? It's too loud to practice in the house, so where can they play? Will they break up before their park performance?

programs.title: Peter Rabbit
programs.sub_title: The Tale of the Mice on the Move
programs.desc: When Peter promises to find the mice a new home, locating an alternative mouse-house proves to be an adventure in itself.
